$comment: Source of truth for the three generated README badge groups and 62 checked-in, self-contained SVG badges. Vector geometry and source/fallback notes are vendored so generation needs only Node.js and never fetches at runtime.

sourcePolicy.simpleIcons: simple-icons@16.28.0 vectors are vendored from the pinned npm package; brand rights and guidelines remain brand-specific.
sourcePolicy.official: Official vectors are vendored from the first-party URL recorded on each icon.
sourcePolicy.fallback: Clean monograms or a generic terminal glyph are used only where the audit found no reusable compact vector.

source.reason: The official Azure architecture pack has no generic Azure product mark; use a clean A monogram rather than an unverified redraw.

cli.markup: <rect x="1.5" y="3.5" width="21" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m6 9 3 3-3 3m5 0h6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

source.reason: A terminal prompt represents any installed CLI or API without claiming one shell brand.
No approved compact OpenAI vector was supplied for this README; use the audited OAI monogram fallback.
No reusable first-party compact vector was verified; use xAI rather than the unrelated X social-network mark.
Radius publishes no reusable compact logo or media kit.
No reusable first-party compact asset kit or Simple Icons vector was verified.
The project SVG embeds a raster image rather than reusable vector geometry, so the badge uses a clean SGL monogram.
No reusable first-party Llama model-family vector was verified; do not substitute Meta or llama.cpp branding.
The open-model project has no compact gpt-oss family logo; do not use the OpenAI corporate mark as a model-family mark.
